assessment.conclusion: f16 + scratch reuse delivers ~20% improvement. 30% target missed. Per Architect Q2 pre-decision: i8 fallback is warranted but deferred to a follow-up task. f16 is still the correct default: cosine drift ≤0.001 for unit-norm vectors, blob size halved (1536→768 bytes), graceful legacy decode in place.
assessment.why_30pct_missed: cosine_similarity computation on 384 f32 floats dominates the hot loop at ~80% of total scan time; the decode bandwidth saving is real but not the bottleneck at 100k scale.

notes: 1M bench requires BENCH_LARGE_SIZE=1 (see bench file header for memory estimate: ~1.8 GB).
f32 reference measured by temporarily reverting db.rs/models.rs to pre-f16 state.
These numbers are on a dev machine; treat as order-of-magnitude, not absolute targets.
i8 path: would require integer dot-product SIMD, likely 2-3x speedup on decode, but worse cosine fidelity for non-unit-norm vectors.
